_readme: PDIG quality gate exception register. Every entry must carry a REAL category from {generated, migration, schema, fixture, vendor, lockfile, pure-data} and an auditable reason. Entries are keyed by repo-relative path. Generated-code is auto-detected by the gate (path or header) and does NOT need an entry.

fileSizeOver300.reason: Schema v1->v3 migration DDL (SCHEMA_V1/V2/V3_STATEMENTS + apply logic). Canonical frozen; three-end logical schema contract (spec/schema).

Payload schema v3 serialization contract (PAYLOAD_TABLES = the 11 logical tables; export/import/migrate must stay byte-exact across platforms; faithful Kotlin port of core/src/services/graph-serialize.ts).

kotlinEscapes.reason: Android Activity lifecycle: FileWorkflowCoordinator is created in onCreate after super.onCreate; lateinit avoids nullable ceremony. Platform boundary.
Conformance runner top-level ROOT initialized in main(); runner is a gate harness, never shipped.

secretPattern.reason: Smoke runner 的合成测试口令（等价于 golden vector 'depmap-test'）；非真实凭据，永不进入产物数据。
